layers.authority: Gwaii Haanas Archipelago Management Board (Council of the Haida Nation and Parks Canada)
layers.process: Every visitor to Gwaii Haanas needs a reservation, the fee and an orientation before entering. Self-guided visitors book and do the orientation online; guided visitors go through their operator. Book with extra weather days.

sources.title: Gwaii Haanas visitor orientation
sources.authority: Parks Canada with the Haida Nation

zone-requirements.note: The lead time is a planning buffer; Parks Canada doesn't publish one. Haida Gwaii's own visitor guidance outside Gwaii Haanas is still to be read.
